_meta.indication: VIZZ is indicated for the treatment of presbyopia in adults.

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-masked, multicenter, active-controlled (brimonidine), parallel-group study
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Percentage of study eyes achieving a >=3-line (15-letter) improvement from baseline in monocular BCDVA at 40 cm and no loss >=5 letters at 4 m at Visit 2 (Day 1), 3 hours post-treatment
pivotal_trials.n: 469 randomized (LNZ101 N=156, LNZ100 N=157, brimonidine N=156)
pivotal_trials.result: Primary endpoint met: at Visit 2 (Day 1) 3 hours postdose, responder rate was 64.3% for LNZ100 (aceclidine 1.75%, the approved VIZZ product) vs 11.5% for brimonidine; difference 52.8% (95% CI 43.8%, 61.8%), p<0.0001 (LNZ101 combination 49.0%).

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-masked, multicenter, placebo (vehicle)-controlled, parallel-group study
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Percentage of study eyes achieving a >=3-line (15-letter) improvement from baseline in monocular BCDVA at 40 cm and no loss >=5 letters at 4 m at Visit 2 (Day 1), 3 hours post-treatment
pivotal_trials.n: 229 randomized (LNZ101 N=76, LNZ100 N=77, vehicle N=76)
pivotal_trials.result: Primary endpoint met: responder rate 70.59% for LNZ100 (aceclidine 1.75%, the approved VIZZ product) vs 7.9% vehicle; difference 62.8%, p<0.0001

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions: instillation site irritation (20%), dim vision (16%), headache (13%); conjunctival hyperemia (8%) and ocular hyperemia (7%) in >5%
target_moa: Cholinergic muscarinic (M3) receptor agonist; a pupil-selective miotic that contracts the iris sphincter muscle producing a pinhole effect that extends depth of focus
modality: Small molecule; VIZZ is aceclidine hydrochloride 1.75% (equivalent to 1.44% aceclidine) ophthalmic solution (the LNZ100 monotherapy arm), not the LNZ101 aceclidine+brimonidine combination

advisory_committee.vote: An Advisory Committee meeting was not deemed necessary for this NDA.

summary.text: Standard review 505(b)(1) NDA approved based on substantial evidence of effectiveness from two adequate and well-controlled phase 3 trials (CLARITY-1 and CLARITY-2); no expedited program designations.

citations.quote: This new drug application (NDA 218585) for aceclidine ophthalmic solution 1.44% (VIZZ) (equivalent to 1.75% aceclidine) was submitted in accordance with Section 505(b)(1) of the Federal Food Drug and Cosmetic Act
Substantial evidence of effectiveness (SEE) was established with two or more adequate and well-controlled clinical investigations.
The Applicant conducted two similarly designed phase 3 pivotal studies Study CLARITY-1 and Study CLARITY-2
